errors.evidence: The pie chart clearly contains four sectors (yellow, gray, orange, and blue), not three.
The chart has one blue sector ('20 или повече') and one orange sector ('между 10 и 20'), not two blue sectors.

The description fails to mention the categories associated with the two largest slices. The yellow slice (57.1%) corresponds to 'никога' (never), and the gray slice (26.2%) corresponds to 'по-малко от 10' (less than 10).
